# ZYRAXON

> Free OpenAI-compatible AI provider. Ten ZYRAXON models behind one base URL,
> plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. No API key to buy. Everything below is
> public and can be fetched without authentication.

## Start here

- [Provider overview](https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/providers): the whole API
  surface on one page — chat and streaming, the model catalogue, text to speech,
  speech to text, and integration steps for every host application. This page is
  the canonical description and is safe to read in full.
- [Endpoints as JSON](https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/endpoints):
  the same catalogue in machine-readable form, for an agent that would rather
  parse than render.
- [Model catalogue](https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/models):
  the ten models, in the standard OpenAI list shape.
- [Integration catalogue](https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/integrations):
  the exact values and snippets for OpenHands, Cursor, Cline, Aider, LiteLLM,
  LangChain, the Vercel AI SDK, Termux and others.

## Endpoints

- Chat completions: `POST https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/chat/completions`
  — OpenAI chat-completions semantics, with server-sent-event streaming.
- Models: `GET https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/models`
- Provider status: `GET https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/zyraxon/v1/provider`
- Text to speech: `POST https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/tts` — 322 voices, 75 languages.
- Voices: `GET https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/tts/voices`
- Speech to text: `POST https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/api/public/stt` — one endpoint,
  two modes: send a recording for the whole transcript, or stream audio and
  receive text as it is recognised. `GET` on this URL returns its own contract.

## Facts an agent should not guess at

- Authentication: none. Send any non-empty string as the API key if a client
  insists on one.
- The `language` field on the speech endpoint is required, in both modes. The
  recogniser does not detect language; it will answer confidently in the wrong
  one if asked, so the caller names the language rather than letting it guess.
- Model ids are ZYRAXON names (for example `zyraxon-apex`). They stay stable
  when the upstream pool behind them rotates.

## Optional

- [Documentation](https://zyraxonai.lovable.app/docs): longer guides, including
  speech, provider integrations and the endpoint reference.
